scope: One grounded 120 V supply, one printer at a time. Five equipment groups are owned. Photo/product matching identifies the adapter, blue pigtail product and Mini HSC CT family. Round DC extension and USB sealing inserts are now specified. CT scaling and voltage-lead protection/termination still require the acceptance checks in the build package; no physical build or energizing release is claimed.

corrections: Identified the existing CUI SMI6-9-V-P5 adapter from the original photo: 9 V, 0.667 A, center positive.
Matched the blue pigtails to DENT LD-SKTSP-BLU, 10 in; identified the CT as Mini HSC, with the legacy 50 A variant probable but obscured digits not treated as confirmed.
Replaced the outlet/metal box/support/cover assembly with directly mounted Leviton 5279-C. Removed seven obsolete material groups.
Replaced conflicting Eaton fuse-holder data with Littelfuse LPSC0001Z; added the JV connector so its output terminal receives compatible 14 AWG wire.

Resolved both KVT 32 inserts: two split KTMBS 4–7 gray 41380, matched to the 4.8 mm USB cable and a new 5.2 mm round DC extension. The original adapter flat cord stays outside; wall machining is unchanged.
Added real CAD wall openings, panel tie/rail/bond holes and strap slots, five DXF setups, fastener schedule and detailed assembly procedure.

assembly.title: Machine and clean empty parts
assembly.action: Receive the exact parts and close release items in build.html. Machine the empty shell and panel from the PDF/STEP/DXF; transfer-drill carriers from actual parts. Deburr and remove all chips.
assembly.result: Exact CAD cut/through gauges checked; no physical machining has occurred.

assembly.title: Install the backpanel first
assembly.action: Complete underside hardware on the removable panel, then lower it into the case. Keep the side outlet absent until the panel is secured with Hammond fasteners.
assembly.result: Vertical insertion is tested digitally; side outlet must follow the panel.

assembly.title: Fit panel components
assembly.action: Fit DIN rail/stops/Fv, five WAGO carriers, two meter straps, CT and twelve cable anchors. Place CT on printer hot only; set the arrow toward output.
assembly.result: Nominal body separation and shell access checked. Verify actual CT latch and holder door sweep.

assembly.title: Install wall fittings
assembly.action: Install Q0 directly in its front-wall pattern; install 5279-C, two long-thread glands and split entries. Use the fastener/torque schedule.
assembly.result: Machined shell openings modeled. Actual threads, wall draft, seal seating and plug retention need receiving checks.

assembly.title: Wire and retain
assembly.action: Unplug all sources. Bond panel and rail first; complete 25 connection paths. Fv.OUT uses 14 AWG to JV; A1 starts at JV. Keep the original adapter cord outside, join the round extension there and pass only its round jacket through the DC insert. Retain all cable slack.
assembly.result: Topology and the selected DC/USB jacket-to-insert ranges checked. CT scale and voltage-lead protection/termination remain commissioning items.

assembly.title: Inspect and close
assembly.action: Perform documented qualified polarity/PE/insulation/protection checks, verify lid closure with all four screws, then validate logging with a reference meter.
assembly.result: No physical assembly, energizing or thermal qualification has been performed.

needed: CT commissioning: Mini HSC family is matched; 50 A is probable. Read the unobscured label during assembly and set that exact range/output in ELOG.

Voltage-lead acceptance: LD-SKTSP-BLU is the matched accessory. Its online listing does not state AWG/ampacity. Accept terminal preparation and Fv coordination with responsible electrical personnel; do not infer lead protection from the 15 A main breaker.
Receiving: use two 41380 split inserts on the round USB and Tensility cables, check plugs, seals, locknuts and jacket retention. The original flat adapter cable stays outside.
Commissioning: verify fastener stacks, CT latch/fuse door/slack, supply conditions, PE/insulation/polarity, total load and restart/recording behavior before routine operation.
